settings.bootstrap: paired over items, stratified by the truth stratum
settings.unusable: not correct; cost of billed tokens counted
settings.noninferiority: Holm-adjusted one-sided lower bound across the primary chatbots
settings.outcome: non-inferior: Holm-adjusted lower bound above -margin; worse: Holm-adjusted upper bound below -margin; otherwise inconclusive
settings.acceptable_cheaper: Holm-adjusted lower bound above -margin and lower list-price cost per correct answer

gpt.rule: first decile of Jev's top probability within the margin of the chatbot alone

claude.rule: first decile of Jev's top probability within the margin of the chatbot alone

gemini.rule: first decile of Jev's top probability within the margin of the chatbot alone

muse.rule: first decile of Jev's top probability within the margin of the chatbot alone

glm.rule: first decile of Jev's top probability within the margin of the chatbot alone

rule.confidence_routed: Jev on its highest top probabilities, ties by item id
rule.random_routed: the same share handed to Jev at random: the expectation over every set of that size (exact, no seed)
